description:
Requires an API key. The project's USDT wallet: balance.available (what can pay PIX now), balance.reserved (held by PIX payments in progress) and balance.confirming (deposits seen, not yet credited), all in USDT with 6 decimals; the networks accepted RIGHT NOW for deposits (networks[].network, name, assets USDT/USDC, eta_minutes); min_deposit; min_payment_brl (the smallest PIX paid with USDT) and payments_enabled. Call it before lunium_request_usdt_deposit or lunium_pay_pix_with_usdt. sandbox=true means the test simulator: never describe that balance as real money.

Errors: carteira_nao_liberada (acao=parar) → the wallet is not enabled for this key; tell the user. acao=esperar → retry shortly.
name: lunium_get_usdt_wallet
title: USDT wallet balance and networks
